text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno finishes 1st!
Pure determination carries him straight to the Derby throne!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Golshi-san...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Even I gotta wave the white flag here. I give up!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Gotta give 'em at least this much.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Flowers...?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Where did she pull that out from?!
She literally just finished running?!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (No, but...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. I shall accept it.
It would be rude not to accept sincere praise—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Here, this is for you!!
Gold Ship raised the bouquet high toward the heavens...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Pffft! Puh-puh-puh!
Golshi-chan ain't the kind to stay humble
over somethin' this small, no way-sie!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you're so sore about it, try beating me again next time!
Mame-chin is a dummy, big dummy!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wha, wha-what...!
Not a single shred of respect in that attitude...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
How could you do such a thing in front of the children?!
Fix your posture and sit right there, Gold Ship-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: No waaaay!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Kh!? Wait uuuuup!!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: ...Heh... Haha! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
That scary lady is so funny!
She's scary, but... hehehe, hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno—! Run! Golshi's gonna get away!
Hurry up!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Good evening, it's time for the sports news.
Tonight's top story is... this!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "Fenomeno & Gold Ship: A Massive Chase Following the Derby!"

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this was so cute, wasn't it~!
The kids at the venue were having so much fun too~!

text_block_list.name: Kid in Town A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Fenomeno?!

text_block_list.name: Kid in Town A
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!? Wah...

text_block_list.name: Kid in Town B
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, your face looks so scary!
That's the look you have when chasing Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Kid in Town A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! You're right!
Fenomeno's face is...
...the exact same face as when she's with Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Kid in Town A
text_block_list.text: Listen, Fenomeno! Golshi runs with a whoosh, so you've gotta go swoosh or you'll never catch up!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Is it "pyoon", by any chance...?

text_block_list.name: Kid in Town A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! Ehehe... I'll give you this letter, too!
...I wrote it yesterday to put in the mailbox.

text_block_list.name: Kid in Town A
text_block_list.text:
"I like Fenomeno
way more than Golshi!
I really want her to do her best!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
――……
……Aaaaargh!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!
Apparently she watched the Japan Derby on TV!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Through racing, I've finally caught the eyes of children!
Children have finally come to like me!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...A-Ahem! But still,
we shouldn't be satisfied with merely catching their eye.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We model exemplary behavior so that, through admiration,
they will learn to act properly on their own.
That whole process is part of the package.

The Japan Derby race
brought us great results.
Track record, growth, and the cheers of support. Beyond all that, too...
choice_data_list: (I've figured out what she excels at, too.)

text_block_list.text:
—Fenomeno excels
at Tokyo Racecourse.

Fenomeno has a large stride, making it easy for her
to build up speed on the straightaways.

"Hence, it is well-suited to Tokyo Racecourse,
which features a long homestretch after the fourth corner."

—However, the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown,
the Kikuka Sho, is held at Kyoto Racecourse.

If you've followed the Classic Triple Crown route
this far, the next customary step is
to head to the Kikuka Sho.

Plus, Fenomeno excels at long distances.
It makes sense to keep going like this.

In the past, there have been other Umamusume who,
instead of the Kikuka-sho, went after
another crown in the Classic class.

Competing against Senior Class racers at Tokyo Racecourse
to win the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Few have accomplished that in the Classic Class, but—
choice_data_list: (If it's Fenomeno, she can take the Tenno Sho (Autumn) too...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Boss?
choice_data_list: ...! Sorry, I was just lost in thought.

text_block_list.text: Gold Ship will probably not be running in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Envisioning the route to prioritize while weighing the pros and cons.

For now,
keeping the 'Tenno Sho (Autumn)' as an option...
summer was about to begin.
